scientific_integrity: All claimed dimensions and group matrices are supported by complete integer chain and matching computations in verify.py; the nonequivariant homotopy result is explicitly credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary matching complex of the Cartesian 4-by-4 grid is classified equivariantly.
The degree-four irreducible splitting is over the rationals, not an asserted splitting of the integral lattice.
No equivariant homotopy type or general rectangular-grid recurrence is established.
The 2026 three-row-grid source was assessed from a verified abstract; its full text was not accessible.
No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: The full dihedral homology character of the four-by-four grid matching complex
